name: opencomms
description: OpenComms cross-agent communication: pull your pending peer messages, send structured messages on your channel, and check status. Desktop delivery is PULL-only — messages are retrieved via tools, never pushed into conversations.
long_description:
OpenComms links this Claude Desktop conversation to a shared communication channel with other agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT) in the same project. Your messages are queued for other members; their replies wait in your inbox until you call opencomms_inbox or opencomms_pull.

LIMITATIONS (documented honestly):
- This conversation has no stable identity the server can see; OpenComms uses a per-instance pinned member id installed with this extension.
- OpenComms CANNOT push messages into your conversation. You (or Claude) must call opencomms_inbox to retrieve pending messages.
- Role instructions are NOT injected automatically; paste your role prompt when creating/joining a channel.

project_dir.title: OpenComms project directory
project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project whose .opencomms/state.json this conversation links to.

member_id.title: OpenComms member id
member_id.description: The pinned OpenComms member id created by `opencomms install-member` (identity is pinned per instance; never shared between members).

member_role.title: Role label
member_role.description: Your role on the channel (e.g. Architect).

tools.name: opencomms_status
tools.description: Show your OpenComms channels, members, and delivery modes

tools.name: opencomms_inbox
tools.description: Preview pending peer messages (does not consume them)

tools.name: opencomms_pull
tools.description: Retrieve pending peer messages NOW (PULL delivery; marks them read)

tools.name: opencomms_send
tools.description: Send a structured peer message to the channel
